The '''Rori Incident''' was the bombing of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] facility on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]'s moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] by the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Delia Visi]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the attack, Delia Visi became one of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild's]] top 10 most wanted fugitives.<ref name="Fugitives" />
